about.title: About TruBlu
text: Established in 2012, TruBlu Pool Service and Repair is dedicated to providing you the absolute best value in pool service. With over 20 years of pool service, we have what it takes to provide the exceptional service you expect, at a price point you will appreciate! We believe that an honest, results driven approach that has allowed us to meet the needs of countless customers. Join the list of customers today, and find out what it means to have a TruBlu pool!

At TruBlu Pool Service and Repair, we will only work with the best materials/parts available and provide a 90 day guarantee on all repair labor. We never compromise quality for time and give our clients realistic schedules that accommodate their lives. We strive for honest customer service with your satisfaction at the roots of our success.

I started in the aquatics field at 15, life guarding at pools within our community. Through the years, I had the pleasure of learning the business from every angle via positions in cleaning, service and repairs, and finally managing communities pools all cross the Greater Houston area. It was here that I was able to become an Instructor for the National Swimming Pool Foundation, certifying Pool Operators in proper operations and chemicals of public aquatic facilities.
